reason: About CAD $342 to move 10 lakh (317 if first transfer is free) is a lot when my relative in India can handle the paperwork for free, or a CA there charges a few thousand rupees. It is also not launched and FINTRAC is only 'in process', so I would not put savings through it.
objection: 2% is far more than the CA fee plus bank charges I would pay doing it through family, and I would be trusting an unlaunched company with lakhs.
would_change_my_mind: A fee under about 0.5% all-in, FINTRAC registration completed, and a few months of real customer track record.
